summary: Sigma Lithium filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 6, 2026 press release announcing the resumption of mining-industrial operations after a Federal Court of Appeals decision upheld its environmental licenses on technical merits. The ruling granted an emergency motion for suspensive relief against a lower court order by a local federal judge in Teofilo Otoni. Management reaffirmed guidance of 330,000 tonnes annualized lithium oxide concentrate by year-end 2027, citing existing mine and plant capacity. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; this is an operational and legal update, not a special situation.
